english.title: Clean / service / maintain aircraft / vehicle / equipment in prohibited area at Bristol Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without written permission from Bristol Airport Limited, or without lawful authority or reasonable cause or excuse, cleaned, serviced or maintained

(A)_[an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..),]_
(B)_[a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE..),]_
(C)_[equipment, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUIPMENT..),]_

in an area, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AREA..), at Bristol Airport, where such activities were prohibited
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 5.1 and 3.3 of the Bristol Airport Byelaws 2012 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This Byelaw describes an act which is prohibited unless the written permission of Bristol Airport Limited has first been obtained or unless the act is performed by a person acting with lawful authority or reasonable cause or excuse in circumstances in which the obtaining of permission would be likely to hinder that person so acting.
